summary: Narrow steep house-lined street with no room to pull off the lane.
reasons: Narrow lane, trees and fences at edge
Homes 12 m or less at the lower end

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes line both sides, nearest 12 m from the south end and 13 m at the start.
drivers.access_and_room: Roughly one parked car wide; verge is kerb-to-hedge with no pull-off, so a van would sit in the lane.
drivers.convention: Only a couple of cars park on the street; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Steep: about 12% mean grade, up to 15%
Homes within about 25 m all round
sun_shade: Mixed; hedges and trees shade the east side, open lane to the sky.
